The '''Z-9 [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] projector''' was manufactured by [[Sirplex/Legends|Sirplex]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] installed these units into their [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].
